title: Issue with dash pairing (not a known issue)
symptom: When a command is sent to the Dash Pod, an Android toast message 'Pairing from InplayBLE rejected' appears twice, then the command executes successfully. Each command takes 30-60 seconds. Some users experience connection loops, inability to connect or find the pod, and need to disable/enable Bluetooth or restart the phone.
cause: The thread suggests the issue may be caused by changed Bluetooth boards in the pods, or by other apps spamming Bluetooth requests (e.g., Samsung earbuds, Mini, BMW apps). Also, enabling the 'Bond BT device on Android 15+...' option on Android 16 can cause problems.
fix: Disable the 'Bond BT device on Android 15+...' option on Android 16. Revoke the Nearby Devices permission for almost all other apps. Disabling and enabling Bluetooth or restarting the phone can temporarily help.
settings_changed: Bond BT device on Android 15+... → disabled
evidence_quote: Don‘t enable the „Bond BT device on Android 15+ …“ on Android 16. This option is for Android 15 only.
